notes.title: Status Update
notes.notes:
Hello All!

I've been out of contact for way too long!  I took a small hiatus to make a game called Million Monster Militia out now on Itch. [url=https://dejobaan.itch.io/mmm]MMM[/url]

I have started to ramp back up on Alpha One production.  I'm reassessing some things.  I'm looking at some new victory mechanics that should help ground the game with a more diverse end-goal.

I've taken the demo down for now since it's so far out of date.  All weapons have been changed to Abilities with cooldowns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40694435/0035dfe3bc6a861ff3705dc5ebc76534d25ab85d.png[/img]

Soon [b]workers[/b] will be added to base/outposts and will need to be managed. I'm looking forward to seeing that in action!

I'm still aiming to release later this year.

Stay tuned for more update or follow:[url=https://www.spacecapsulegames.com/devlog]spacecapsulegames.com/devlog[/url]

Thanks!
Jon

notes.title: Alpha One Developer Live Stream
notes.notes:
Come join the developer livestream for an extended look at Alpha One! There will also be a Q&A!

You can ask about Alpha One's game design, art direction, music composition, code and literally anything you would like to know! See you there!

Alpha One is a 4X-lite, action-strategy game where you control a lone space capsule to gather and control resources in another galaxy! Stranded in deep space after an accident you are pitted against an unknown opponent in a galactic struggle to get home!
